resource_policy.memory_admission: a process may use any memory still available below the WSL total cap; monitor aggregate MemAvailable instead of applying ulimit -v
resource_policy.process_parallelism: one heavy probe may use up to four workers while aggregate WSL memory remains available
resource_policy.process_priority: normal for exact certificates; nice +10 for discovery-only numerical searches

audit_policy: Same-thread reconstruction is not an independent audit. Require a separate implementation or reviewer before any public promotion.
promotion_policy: Do not advance past survivor_deepening or change the public OPG status without the exact generic determinant sign, contact-stratum closure, and independent audit. Preserve exact negative route evidence.
